applications.latestSubject: Looking for - Program Manager (Vehicle) – Auburn Hills, MI (Onsite)
applications.notes: Hi, My name is Gaurav and I am helping our direct client source for an immediate role which might be of interest to you. Please review the job description as below. I look forward to hearing from you soon. APN Consulting, Inc. is a progressive IT staffing and services company offering innovative business solutions to improve client business outcomes. We focus on high impact technology solutions in ServiceNow, Fullstack, Cloud & Data, and AI / ML. Due to our globally expanding service offerings we are seeking top-talent to join our teams and grow with us. Job Title : Program Manager (Vehicle) Location : Auburn Hills, MI (Onsite) Client: TCS Job Description: We are seeking an experienced Vehicle Program Manager to support the integration and launch of new vehicle programs across multiple software platforms. This is a highly technical and cross-functional role requiring expertise in software integrations, APIs, data exchange formats, issue analysis, and automotive software development processes. The ideal candidate will act as the primary technical coordination point during pre-launch and launch activities, working closely with development, testing, operations, architects, and business teams to ensure successful vehicle launches. The candidate should possess a strong understanding of automotive software systems, connected vehicle platforms, and end-to-end feature integration flows. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with development, testing, operations, architecture, and business teams to support vehicle software integration activities. Analyze and validate software integration interfaces, including APIs, file formats, messaging systems, and data exchange mechanisms. Track dependencies, risks, issues, and blockers, ensuring timely resolution and escalation when required. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of end-to-end feature flows across the vehicle software ecosystem. Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to bridge knowledge gaps and support impact analysis during pre-launch activities. Schedule, facilitate, and lead technical triage meetings to drive issue resolution and alignment across teams. Investigate reported issues and determine validity through technical analysis and troubleshooting. Review logs, telemetry, documentation, and system behavior to identify root causes and recommend solutions. Route issues to the appropriate engineering teams when deeper investigation or remediation is required. Follow up on open actions and ensure assigned teams meet committed resolution timelines. Own and manage pre-launch issues through closure, providing regular status updates to stakeholders. Support launch readiness activities and proactively mitigate risks to ensure successful vehicle launches. Drive cross-functional collaboration to prevent last-minute escalations and launch delays. Wishing you the very best. Gaurav Kumar APN Consulting Inc Monmouth Junction NJ 08852 Gaurav.Kumar@apnconsultinginc.com (609) 924-3400 APN Consulting,

applications.notes: Hi Tirth, Thank you for your application for the AI & Automation Engineer position at Go West IT. We really appreciate your interest. We wish we had the opportunity to personally respond to everyone, but with hundreds of applicants for the position, that would be a very difficult and time-consuming task. Please know that we look at every single applicant holistically and thoughtfully. We review professional backgrounds in resumes, potentially transferable skills, recommendations and summaries on LinkedIn profiles, etc. Most important of all, we're carefully reading answers to the online questions, which are extremely important to us. We are still collecting applications, and will contact you should we decide to proceed with an interview. If we feel that you will be someone who is set up for success in this position long-term, will make a truly valuable contribution, and have the potential to be a great fit and happy in the role, you will hear from us. If other candidates better meet that criteria and/or if this particular position isn't the right fit, we'll absolutely keep you in mind for other opportunities in the future. In the meantime, we wish you the best of luck in your search. —— We want you to be in control of your personal data. You can request a data correction or request to be deleted from our database. As a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), we partner with top-tier Fortune 500 companies across the US and maintain a robust global presence across Canada, the UK, and India. How We Accelerate Your Job Search We don't just submit resumes—we use a personalized, end-to-end approach to match your technical expertise with the right opportunities: * Exclusive Access: Direct placement for non-public roles at leading Fortune 500 organizations. * Targeted Matching: Tailored alignment between your specific skill set and target positions. * Dedicated Support: Comprehensive guidance covering resume optimization, technical training, interview preparation, and onboarding. What Our Service Package Includes 1. Interview Preparation & Offer Negotiation * Best practices and key strategies for video and on-site interviews. * Preparation for frequently asked technical and behavioral questions. * Active tracking and management of all submissions and interview stages. * End-to-end post-offer support: salary negotiation, background/reference checks, document verification, and onboarding guidance. 5. Additional Exclusive Benefits * Dedicated Personal Recruiter: Assigned specifically to manage your daily applications and client interview scheduling. * Automated Tools: Automated Interview Set-up System (AIS) and LinkedIn automation tools to scale your applications and networking efforts up to 10x faster. applications.latestSubject: Raleigh-based Data Engineer for Wake County IT
applications.notes: Hi Bonnie, I saw your post about the Data Engineer opening on the D&A team at Wake County IT and wanted to reach out directly. I’m based in *Raleigh* and can support the 80% remote hybrid schedule with in-person collaboration at the Raleigh office when needed. Best thing is I can start as early as needed. My background matches the role’s core needs: operationalized Python/SQL pipelines, SQL Server, data quality validation, scheduling, monitoring, error handling, governed reporting, and BI-ready data models. At Texas A&M Utilities and Energy Services, I built and supported production pipelines across utility consumption, pricing, billing, sensor, weather, solar, CHP, and spreadsheet sources, with validation, retries, logs, and stakeholder reporting. At TCS, I worked on regulated Equifax data pipelines using Python, SQL, GCP, and Airflow across 10M+ daily records. I’m especially interested in Wake County because the work connects strong data engineering with public-sector decision support and community outcomes. I’d be grateful if you could take a look at my resume for req9617. applications.latestSubject: The silence isn't feedback
applications.notes: Hey Tirth, I want to talk about the silence. If you've sent applications and heard nothing back - no rejection, no acknowledgment, just nothing - I know what that can start to feel like. Like the market is telling you something about your worth. Like you're being passed over for a reason nobody will say out loud. I've been there. Eight hundred applications. Weeks of silence. And the silence is the worst part, because your brain fills it with explanations that almost always land in the wrong place. Here's what the silence actually means in most cases: Your application entered a queue with 300 others. The ATS filtered it. Or a recruiter spent six seconds on it during a Tuesday afternoon when they had forty more to get through. The decision wasn't careful. It wasn't personal. It was volume. The hiring process wasn't designed to find the best candidate. It was designed to efficiently reduce 400 applications to 15. Most of the filtering happens before anyone with context about the role has looked at your name. That's not an excuse for the system. It's just useful to know - because it means the silence is information about the process, not information about you. Next time I want to talk about what this process is actually costing you - beyond the rejections. — Leela Co-founder, Scale.jobs _We apply. applications.latestSubject: Would your resume make a French inspector proud?
applications.notes: If you’ve ever gone weeks or even months without a nibble on your job-hunt… It’s easy to beat yourself up thinking, “No-one wants to hire me!” But here’s the thing: The problem _ISN’T_ that employers hate your resume… It’s that they don’t read it in the first place! You see, employers have a technology that - if not taken into account - will end your chances in the hiring process before it’s even begun. What is this technology? It’s called an Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and it tests your resume on 2 basic things: Test #1: _Can I scan this resume?_ (If it can’t, because your resume uses a weird format, it likely won't get very far.) And Test #2: _How relevant is this resume to the job description?_ If the ATS gives you a poor relevance score, your resume gets kicked to the bottom of the candidate pile, where a hiring manager will click “reject” - without even reading it. (According to Harvard Business School, 88% of candidates are rejected like this) _“But Rohan, even with a low score, a hiring manager can still read my resume, right?”_ Well.. applications.latestSubject: CS#367: I love being nervous (+ more)
applications.notes: View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/38de75dd-6610-4ea8-a177-3c5184f62435/image.png?t=1767869729) Caption: You probably won’t get through a good career without regularly doing things that make you nervous. So I think learning how to handle that feeling is a much more useful skill than trying to outgrow it. Today’s _Mentor’s Corner_ is about what’s helped me personally. ==**If you haven’t tried this yet, you really should**==**:** Our new personality assessment takes ~3 minutes, but gives you a surprisingly detailed read on how you think, work and relate to other people. It’s built on decades of psychology research. This kind of deep personality insight normally costs $50-100, but this is free (I’m covering the costs). A new thing we added is that you can add a partner, friend or coworker and see why you click. I’ve done it with 20 people already - it’s awesome. ==[**Take the test →**](http://coached.com/quiz)== ——————————————————————————— _This is __[Coached Weekly](https://coached.com/newsletter)__, my career notes where I share the tiny % of ideas that actually work in real careers. It takes 5 minutes to read, but could speed up your career by years. I write this myself (no AI) and I read your replies. —Rohan Mahtani (__[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohanmahtani/)__)_ _Want to log in to Coached or see your personality assessments? __[Login](http://coached.com/login.php)__._ ## **Disagree with a question, not a statement** When someone senior proposes something flawed, "I disagree, that won't work" forces them to defend it. Now it's their ego vs. your point, and their ego wins. Instead, ask the question that leads them to the flaw: _"How are we thinking about this handling the Q4 volume spike?"_ If the flaw is real, they'll hit it themselves and an idea someone talks _themselves_ out of dies, with no loser in the room. If there's actually a good answer, you just look thorough instead of wrong. applications.notes: 08/27/26 5:53 PM Dear Tirth, My name is Alex and I'm an IT recruiter at Epsilon Solutions. Our records show that you are an experienced IT professional with experience in AI . This experience is relevant to one of my current openings. Title: AI Engineer Location: Remote 100% - Canada. Terms: 12+ months Job Overview Senior‑level role on a five‑person engineering team building a production‑grade healthcare conversational GenAI platform. The stack centers on Python 3.12+ , FastAPI , and Google ADK 2.0 as the primary multi‑agent orchestration and structured‑output toolkit, deployed on Azure . The role emphasizes backend service development, GenAI workflow engineering, secure integrations, and operational ownership for patient‑facing conversational experiences. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain backend APIs and services using Python 3.12+ and FastAPI. Develop and operate multi‑agent GenAI workflows using Google ADK 2.0 as the primary orchestration framework. Integrate and tune LLM providers and GenAI toolkits (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). Support and extend workflows built with other orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI) and ensure interoperability. Implement RAG, prompt engineering, structured output validation, and AI guardrails to ensure safe, reliable model behavior. Build domain task handlers for healthcare workflows (care tasks, medications, scheduling) and integrate with clinical systems as required. Leverage Azure services (Cosmos DB, App Configuration, Key Vault, Event Hubs, Application Insights) for data, configuration, secrets, and telemetry. Ensure API security and PHI protection using JWT/OAuth and security best practices. Contribute to architecture, code reviews, production support, observability, and incident response. Author and maintain automated tests (pytest) and support CI/CD and containerized deployments. Required Qualifications professional software development experience. Strong production experience in Python and asynchronous frameworks ( FastAPI preferred). Hands‑on experience with Google ADK 2.0 for multi‑agent orchestration and structured LLM outputs. Familiarity with other LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI) and ability to work across toolchains. Demonstrated knowledge of prompt engineering , RAG , structured output validation, and AI safety/guardrail patterns. Experience integrating OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Google ADK 2.0 . Practical experience with Azure services (Cosmos DB, Key Vault, App Configuration). Familiarity with Docker , CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions), and containerized production deployments. Experience with event‑driven architectures and workflow engines. Strong understanding of JWT/OAuth and API security best practices. Proven ability to operate with high ownership in a small, fast‑paced team. After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with another candidate for this position. This decision was not easy, as we were impressed by your qualifications and experiences. However, we feel that another applicant’s skill set aligns more closely with our current needs. We truly appreciate your interest in Prolaio and the opportunity to learn more about you. We will keep your resume on file for future openings that may be a better fit for your skills and experiences. Thank you again for your time and effort. We wish you the best of luck in your job search and future endeavors. Please feel free to apply for other roles with us in the future if you see a position that interests you. applications.latestSubject: Application Received for Pricing Data Engineer
applications.notes: Dear Tirth, Thank you for applying to the position of Pricing Data Engineer at McDermott Will & Schulte. We know that a career search takes significant time and effort, and we appreciate that you have selected us as a potential employer. In an effort to provide transparency around our recruiting process, we have outlined what you can expect from here: - If selected to move forward in the process for this or any other position, a member of our Business Professional Recruiting team will contact you directly - You can check the status of your application(s), update your information, and/or apply for additional opportunities at any time by navigating to your candidate profile on our careers website - You will receive an email if you are no longer being considered for the position(s) to which you applied Thank you again for your interest in joining our Firm. applications.latestSubject: Coached: Why I think “leaving a legacy” is just BS + more
applications.notes: Welcome to your first edition of Coached + career hacks real career strategy for ambitious people Tirth — this is your second Coached Weekly . Quick refresher : it's your career strategy email which contains the tactics, tools and hacks that I've seen work in real careers. My goal is to make this the highest ROI thing you read each week. It takes just 5 minutes to read but it’s the kind of stuff you’ll reuse for years. I’ve coached people for over a decade — this is the best of what I’ve learned, distilled into a short tactical email. The 20-second Career tactic A tactic you can use today. I teach it in 20 seconds. How to write with authority Surprisingly, simple words in our emails can subtly undermine our authority. Phrases like 'I think', 'sorry', or 'maybe' might sound polite, but they actually project uncertainty, not confidence. Here are some before-and-after examples to illustrate: Projects uncertainty : "I'm no expert but I think we maybe should do..." Confidence : "We should do..." or "I recommend we do..." Overly apologetic : "I'm so sorry for the delay..." Just right : "Thanks for your patience" Before : " Just wanted to check in, how is everything going with X" After : "Checking in — what's the status of X?" Before : " Apologies for [missing your email / an error / contacting you]" After : Pay attention to the times you say sorry for things that really aren't your fault. Then, try to actively reduce them. Remove those phrases from your everyday vocabulary — and start being more direct — and you'll start to appear more confident in your communication. Mentor's Corner Insights put together by me. One practical lesson a week that will make a measurable impact on your career, delivered right to you — for $0. Why I think “leaving a legacy” is just BS Something I like to ask people who ask me for career advice is, “what motivates you?” And a common reply I get is: “To leave a legacy.” And that’s when I stop them. Not because leaving a legacy is “bad”. It’s not. (I think it’s good to have a moral compass, and think, “would future generations approve of what I’m doing?”) But as a primary motivator? I’m not a fan. Today, I’m gonna explain why, and share what I think is a far more “fruitful” thing to focus on instead. Here we go. 🤥 Is it even possible? I read somewhere that the 5 inventions that’ve had the biggest impact on human history were: fire, gunpowder, the transistor, the condom and the Internet. Probably true. And yet, I don’t know who invented any of them! (Can you?) If people who permanently changed humanity have been forgotten, how realistic is it for us to expect our careers to leave lasting legacies? 🤔 Who’s “they”? “I want people to remember me when I’m gone,” we tell ourselves. But who exactly are these “people”? Case in point: Back in 2014, the Toronto Maple Leafs ice hockey team played a game on “Giants of Africa Day” to honor the great Nelson Mandela. applications.latestSubject: Thank you for applying to SimplePractice
applications.notes: Thank you for applying to SimplePractice! We are excited that you have decided to explore a career with our company and are thrilled to start this journey with you. To get started, let us tell you a little about our recruiting process… First, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will review your resume (yes, a REAL person – no AI here!) to compare it to the skills and competencies needed for our role. If your experiences seem to fit what we are looking for, we will reach out to you via email within a week or two to set up a time for us to connect for a call. This call will be a great opportunity for us to learn more about you (the person behind the resume), you to learn more about us (the team @ SimplePractice), and our interview process. Occasionally, the timing or fit is not quite right, and you won’t get selected for a phone interview. applications.latestSubject: N26: Thank you for applying to Data Engineer - Platform Engineering!
applications.notes: Hi Tirth, Thanks for applying to help us build N26, the bank the world loves to use! We know applying for a job can be exciting, and at times nerve-racking. To provide you some visibility, here's a rundown on our hiring process: Application Review 📜 and Timing ⏳ All of our applications are reviewed by humans - not robots. Due to the volume of applications we receive, reviewing all profiles and providing feedback to each candidate proves to be time-consuming. We aim to get back to applicants within 1 week. Generally we’re pretty good at this, but sometimes it can run a bit longer. We've been there too, so for that reason we’ll do our best to keep the wait to a minimum. Interview Process 🤝 If unfortunately you don’t make it past the CV review, it means that currently you do not meet the requirements for the specific role (for now). If it seems like a good fit, then we’ll reach out to you. In general you can expect a series of digital meetings with different team members paired with a practical challenge. The full interview cycle usually averages between 2 to 4 weeks, but this might vary based on seniority of the role and agenda availability. Successful applicants will be asked to submit professional references and complete a criminal record check. We'll share more details about this when you reach this stage in our hiring process. In the meantime, check out more on what life could be like with us on our LinkedIn ( https://www.linkedin.com/company/n26/ ) page, our N26 Blog ( https://n26.com/en-eu/blog/category/insiden26 ) and our People of N26 Instagram ( https://www.instagram.com/peopleofn26/ ) profile. Thanks again for your interest in building the bank the world loves to use! Best regards, Your N26 Recruitment Team

applications.latestSubject: Coached: A short story on reinvention (+ more)
applications.notes: Welcome to your first edition of Coached + career hacks real career strategy for ambitious people Tirth — so far at Resume Worded, we've been focused on giving you the best support for your resume. But there's more to a career than a good resume . That's where this email - the Coached Weekly - comes in. Each week, you'll get career strategy from me. I've coached people for a decade and I distill the tiny % of ideas and tactics that I've seen work in real careers. No-fluff. 500,000+ smart professionals read these emails religiously and many say the tactics they've learned have substantially sped up their careers. So, my guess is you'll like it too. But, I'll let you decide. Let's dive in. The 20-second Career tactic A tactic you can use today. I teach it in 20 seconds. How to introduce yourself better Most people introduce themselves exactly the same way ("Hi, I'm [name], I work at [company] as a [title]"). It’s boring, forgettable and makes conversations with new people tough. ❌ Bad : " I moved to NYC for work, and I'm a data scientist at Resume Worded. " That story's boring because EVERYONE in New York moved there for work. ✅ Good : " I'm a bit of a third culture kid. Grew up in Singapore and London, which explains my funny accent. Decided to move to New York for the energy and ended up falling in love with data science." You want your story to be original. Make this small change and people will instantly find you more interesting and memorable. Building relationships gets easier when you give people multiple connection points. Mentor's Corner Insights put together by me. One practical lesson a week that will make a measurable impact on your career, delivered right to you — for $0. How to reinvent yourself in your career: a true story One person I think is cool is Mario Ancic. He was the number 7 tennis player in the world. Beat Federer on grass. Made the Wimbledon semifinals. Then mononucleosis forced him to end his career at 26. Instead of becoming another ex-athlete who got stuck in their identity and now commentate or coach, he went to Columbia Law School. Passed the bar. Rose up the ranks at different law firms. Then he switched into finance. Now, he's a principal at a major private equity firm. What's cool : His LinkedIn doesn't mention tennis. Not in his headline. Not in his bio. Only a tiny mention hidden if you drill into all his work experiences. His LinkedIn profile That's the part that gets me. Most people who achieve something significant spend the rest of their lives reminding everyone about it. They become prisoners of their best achievement. Ancic just moved on. Started over as a law student. Then again as a junior associate. Then again in private equity. Each time accepting being the beginner in the room despite having been world-class at something else. Some takeaways from his story: Reinvention is hard, but it's possible . Just because you've spent years becoming great at one field doesn't mean you can't excel at something com

Design and build bulk extraction automation components that reduce or eliminate manual work, using AWS hosted services and patterns consistent with the GDMS architecture. Develop Lambda/Node.js and Fargate based processing functions to perform extraction, transformation, validation, and related processing for GDMS utility workflows across supported schemas. Implement AWS Step Functions workflows for Claims, Underwriting, and Ad hoc extraction types, orchestrating OpenSearch/DynamoDB queries, processing steps, and downstream actions. In depth hands on working experience of Data modeling and Database Design In depth hands on working experience of SQL, NoSQL and Big Data knowledge In depth understanding of Azure Database Security Particularly Encryption, Obfuscation, Role based Access control, etc. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Tools knowledge for Data Disciplines A background in computer science and database management. applications.latestSubject: Thank you for applying to Redwood Materials
applications.notes: Hi Tirth, Thank you for your interest in Redwood Materials! Your email has been received and we're excited that you would consider joining our team. Redwood’s goal is to develop and deploy new technologies for dramatically increasing the scope and scale of recycled and sustainable materials in global supply chains. We’re passionate about building a sustainable future and changing the world with a small team. With that said, we’re thrilled that you’re excited about helping us solve this super important and difficult environmental problem. We will review your information as soon as we can and we'll be in touch if your qualifications align with our needs. Due to the volume of emails received, we want to be respectful of your time and let you know that we will only be reaching out to candidates whose skillsets best match our roles. If our team feels that you’re a fit, we will contact you shortly about next steps. If you don’t hear back immediately, don't worry! We're growing fast and will have new roles opening up in the future, so please keep an eye on our website for updates! Recycle with Us Redwood’s focus is to take both end-of-life electric vehicle batteries and other lithium-ion powered consumer devices and then recycle, refine, and remanufacture them into new products here in America. The largest lithium and cobalt mines in the western hemisphere can be found in the junk drawers of America and we’re on a mission to collect as many of these old products as possible. We encourage all candidates, visitors, and guests to bring old phones, laptops, tablets, electric toothbrushes, and any other rechargeable device with a lithium-ion battery. For more information about our consumer recycling program, please visit our website ( https://www.redwoodmaterials.com/recyclewithus ). Thanks, Redwood Recruiting

applications.latestSubject: Tirth, we have received your application
applications.notes: Hello Tirth, We appreciate you taking the time to submit your application for the Data Engineer role. We will be in touch should your qualifications be suitable for the position. So that you are aware, our recruitment process is usually split into a number of stages: Exploratory introduction meeting Technical skills interview Behavioral and situational interview You will be advised at each stage if you have progressed to the next, and some may occur at the same interview meeting. The process is designed for you to get to know our company and team style as well as for us to get to know you. You should also give us an idea of who you are, what your overall skills are and where you see yourself in your career, as well as why you're the best person for the job! The technical skills interview will focus on the skills and knowledge you have put forward in your application. The final interview focuses on behavioural questions based on your previous employment or academic experience. You will also be asked situational questions which will relate to the role for which you are applying to see how you can fit in with what we're trying to achieve. Due to the volume of applications we receive please be aware that you may not receive a personal response beyond this. Incomplete applications such as those which did not answer questions or complete testing are severely disadvantaged. Thank you again for taking the time to apply - we'll be in touch if you are selected to move forward.
